entities.summary: Adam Creighton is a Canadian former professional ice hockey player. He played 708 career National Hockey League games after winning the Memorial Cup in 1984 as a member of the Ottawa 67's. Creighton played professionally for the Buffalo Sabres, Chicago Blackhawks, New York Islanders, Tampa Bay Lightning and St. Louis Blues. His father Dave was also a former NHL player.
